title: Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, now available to all users to unlock powerful insights and enhance your data exploration.

title: Take Control of Your Content's Files
summary: We've launched exciting new features that provide you with unparalleled control to manage your images and files, including easy uploading and flexible display options, right within your editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to gain complete transparency into our recently shipped features, current priorities, and exciting future plans.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: Enjoy a more intuitive and visually appealing checkbox experience with easier clicking and dragging, designed to streamline your tasks.

title: Unlock Seamless Real-time Collaboration
summary: Experience a new level of teamwork with our enhanced collaboration features, making co-editing more intuitive and efficient for everyone.

title: Seamless Access to Shared Content
summary: Effortlessly discover and interact with all shared ideas and collaborative content from your network, making teamwork and knowledge sharing more intuitive than ever.

title: Noeko Speaks Your Language
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out comprehensive support for multiple international languages, making our platform truly global.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source
summary: With Noeko now open source, users will gain maximum control, direct involvement, and full transparency in the project's ongoing development.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base with unprecedented clarity by filtering your graph by tags and time, and effortlessly track shared content with your connections.

title: Advanced Search & Custom Views
summary: Experience a more powerful way to discover and organize your information with advanced filtering, dynamic sorting, and the ability to save your custom search views.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: Explore your linked ideas with enhanced visual previews and interactive modes, allowing you to organize your thoughts more intuitively than ever before.

title: Noeko Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: Experience unparalleled control and unlock advanced capabilities with Noeko's new self-hosting options and premium plans, designed to fit your unique needs.

title: Enhanced Visual Themes
summary: We're refreshing our current visual themes and introducing exciting new options to personalize your experience and make our app even more beautiful.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: Our latest update brings more accurate and timely greetings to your homepage, creating a perfectly tailored welcome at any moment.

title: Effortless Tag Management
summary: Efficiently manage your categorized content by performing quick actions like removing, deleting, or viewing items directly from any tag list.

title: Expand Your Knowledge Base with More Content Sources
summary: Effortlessly integrate a much wider range of essential information, including dynamic videos, insightful websites, and various text documents, directly into your workflow to enrich your understanding.
